2. Sample Data for Initial Load.

SOL_ID=1089, SET_ID='BRFC' will be updated on the next run
SOL_ID=1156, SET_ID='BRFC' will be deleted from the source on the next run
SOL_ID=1123, SET_ID='BRFC' will have no change in details, only filename date will be changed
SOL_ID=99999999, SET_ID='BRFC' will be inserted as new record in the source on the next run(not yet inserted on the target table)


SELECT FILE_NAME,SCD_Start_Date,SCD_End_Date,* FROM
EDS.DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE WHERE SOL_ID=1089 AND SET_ID='BRFC'
UNION ALL
SELECT FILE_NAME,SCD_Start_Date,SCD_End_Date,* FROM
EDS.DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE WHERE SOL_ID=1156 AND SET_ID='BRFC'
UNION ALL
SELECT FILE_NAME,SCD_Start_Date,SCD_End_Date,* FROM
EDS.DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE WHERE SOL_ID=1123 AND SET_ID='BRFC'
UNION ALL
SELECT FILE_NAME,SCD_Start_Date,SCD_End_Date,* FROM
EDS.DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE WHERE SOL_ID=99999999 AND SET_ID='BRFC'


3. Run scripts to fabricate updated, deleted , new record and update filename date

UPDATE [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE] SET LCHG_USER_ID='UPDATE_TEST_123', DEL_FLG = 'Y'
WHERE SOL_ID=1089 AND SET_ID='BRFC' AND H = 'D';

DELETE FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE]
WHERE SOL_ID=1156 AND SET_ID='BRFC' AND H = 'D';

UPDATE [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE] SET FILE_NAME=REPLACE(FILE_NAME,'20230901','20231215');

INSERT INTO [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE]
(H,SET_ID,SOL_ID,BANK_ID,ENTITY_CRE_FLG,DEL_FLG,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME,TS_CNT,DUMMY_FLD,FILE_NAME,insert_dttm)
SELECT 'D','99999999' SET_ID,SOL_ID,BANK_ID,ENTITY_CRE_FLG,DEL_FLG,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME,TS_CNT,DUMMY_FLD,FILE_NAME,insert_dttm FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE]  
WHERE SOL_ID=1123 AND SET_ID='BRFC' AND H = 'D';
